description.en: The name of the private instance.

The type of cloud firewall. Valid values:
- **internet**
- **vpc**
- **nat**
The UID of the Alibaba Cloud member account.
The ID of the primary vSwitch.
The IP address of the primary vSwitch.

The type of private DNS. Valid values:
- **PrivateZone**
- **Custom** (default)
The region ID of the instance.
The ID of the standby vSwitch.
The IP address of the standby vSwitch.

descriptions.zh: 使用本接口创建一条对经过NAT防火墙流量放行、拒绝或观察的策略。
descriptions.en: Creates a private DNS endpoint for traffic that passes through the NAT Firewall to allow, deny, or monitor the traffic.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw create-private-dns-endpoint --access-instance-name test --private-dns-type Custom --region-no cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-uf6b5lyul0x000000 --primary-vswitch-id vsw-uf6b0dkyryer8000000 --standby-vswitch-id vsw-8vb6jk75wfcwn000000 --primary-vswitch-ip 10.1.1.1 --standby-vswitch-ip 10.2.2.2 --ip-protocol UDP --port 80 --firewall-type internet --primary-dns 1.1.1.1 --standby-dns 1.1.1.2 --member-uid 2580394279020000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudfw CreatePrivateDnsEndpoint --region cn-hangzhou --RegionNo 'cn-hangzhou' --FirewallType.1 internet --PrimaryVSwitchIp '10.1.1.1' --MemberUid 2580394279020000 --AccessInstanceName test --Port 80 --PrimaryVSwitchId 'vsw-uf6b0dkyryer8000000' --StandbyVSwitchId 'vsw-8vb6jk75wfcwn000000' --StandbyDns '1.1.1.2' --StandbyVSwitchIp '10.2.2.2' --PrimaryDns '1.1.1.1' --VpcId 'vpc-uf6b5lyul0x000000' --PrivateDnsType Custom --IpProtocol UDP
